General Voronin: Rumors say that the Marked One managed to sneak inside CNPP. But there's no confirmation or information on what happened to him afterwards. Some assume he joined the Monolith faction, while others even claim he made a wish like "I want to become the master of the Zone". Anyway, rumors vary, and the Zone has begun expanding rapidly... Soon the Cordon will no longer be the outskirts...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: ScenarioName
General Voronin: Operation "Monolith". Shadow of Chernobyl

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: ScenarioDescription
General Voronin: This scenario shifts the timeline to the moment when the Marked One disables the Brain Scorcher. The military operation "Monolith" is about to begin. To achieve victory, you must capture the territories of Radar, Pripyat, and the Chernobyl NPP before the Marked One reaches the Wish Granter! Faction diplomacy is close to canon. The Emission has triple strength.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].Description
General Voronin: Duty - a faction whose goal is to protect the world from the infection of the Zone. A sufficiently powerful paramilitary group. Favorable positioning, good weaponry, and predisposition to fighting mutants guarantee success in capable hands.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-War
General Voronin: You and your gang are a threat to peace. Time to settle this!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
General Voronin: We want to negotiate a ceasefire with you. Do you agree?

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
General Voronin: We propose an alliance. Together we can carry out a couple of operations against our enemies. Do you agree?

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-BreakAlliance
General Voronin: We will no longer cooperate!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask
General Voronin: Got any spare cash? Times are tough for us. We could use about this much:

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down
General Voronin: Understood. We'll cleanse the Zone of you too!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Down
General Voronin: Shame... but if you insist, so be it.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
General Voronin: No, we definitely won't go for that right now.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
General Voronin: We hope for further cooperation.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-No
General Voronin: No, we definitely won't go for that right now.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-Yes
General Voronin: Oooh, excellent, we have a deal!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No
General Voronin: Sorry, we can't help out right now.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-Yes
General Voronin: Alright, we'll help you out.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-No
General Voronin: Oh, you're making a mistake by refusing!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-Yes
General Voronin: Good, that's reassuring!

General Voronin: Oh, you're making a mistake by refusing!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-Yes
General Voronin: Good, that's reassuring!

General Voronin: You survived! Victory!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].Text-End-EventFlag-Victory
General Voronin: Victory by event flag!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].Text-End-Standart-Lose
General Voronin: Your faction has been completely wiped out in the northern Zone. The group will not recover from such losses for a long time and is unlikely to be taken seriously by other Stalkers anytime soon. Defeat!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].Text-End-Step-Lose
General Voronin: Time's up. You failed to gain control over the Zone. Defeat!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].Text-End-EventFlag-Lose
General Voronin: Defeat! You failed to capture the northern Zone!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Anarchy].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! It would seem the war is finally over. The Zone is controlled by a single faction. But not long ago, its ideology changed - to the very one its founders opposed. Even before the war ended, disagreements were brewing among commanders. It seems a new «War in Zone» is looming... and this one will be purely ideological...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.AntiZone].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Duty has seized the northern Zone and begun active cleansing of territories from mutants. Rumors say that faces never seen before are appearing more frequently within the faction. Is Duty cooperating with the government? Unknown, but Duty members don't let just anyone into the laboratories or near the Chernobyl NPP. Not even all of "their own" are allowed near these places. This "approach" didn't sit well with everyone, and soon other factions decided to start a new large-scale war for the northern territories of the Zone. Among the most active instigators was Freedom, which had managed to recover...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.AntiZone].Text-End-Standart-Lose
General Voronin: Your faction has been completely wiped out in the northern Zone. The group will not recover from such losses for a long time and is unlikely to be taken seriously by other Stalkers anytime soon. Defeat!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Control].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, the leadership made contact with the government and began open cooperation. Not everyone approved. Some Stalkers broke away from the main group and formed their own factions in different sectors of the Zone. A new «War in Zone» is brewing - this time for control over everything within the perimeter.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Crime].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! The northern Zone is now controlled by a powerful faction. And it's not Monolith. Stalkers can now pass beyond Radar, but with certain conditions. They must pay for passage and for "protection". And they must pay constantly, as the upper echelons of the faction are now in the hands of criminal elements. Everything is gradually sliding into ordinary racketeering, looting, and "protection" schemes. New conflicts are brewing. The faction certainly won't remain united while holding the northern Zone...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Exploring].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, the leadership made contact with the government and made certain concessions to avoid conflict with the outside world. Faction members largely supported this direction, as it's much easier to fight an enemy you've studied well. Stalkers in the field have already felt the first results of cooperation: excellent artifact detectors, more precise instruments for marking anomalous zones, vulnerable points of mutants. This allowed faction members to overlook the fact that documents from the laboratories were handed over to the government, and everyone who knew their contents suddenly disappeared for some reason. Allegedly, they "lost interest in the Zone and decided to return home". And to this day, anyone who finds any documents in the Zone's underground facilities disappears...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Growth].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, Duty made contact with the government and began cooperation. Mutants were being eradicated, scientists were being sent into the Zone more frequently. Duty members increasingly noticed secret service agents among them - though perhaps those were just rumors...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Growth].Text-End-Standart-Lose
General Voronin: Your faction has been completely wiped out in the northern Zone. The group will not recover from such losses for a long time and is unlikely to be taken seriously by other Stalkers anytime soon. Defeat!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Mercenary].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! The northern Zone is now controlled by a faction with no connection to Monolith. The original goal of protecting the world from the Zone's infection is almost forgotten. For some reason, mutants are no longer being actively exterminated. Everyone talks about money and how to earn it easier... Organize "safaris for the rich from the outside world"? Or catch mutants for sale? Maybe smuggle a rare artifact through the perimeter into someone's private collection? This approach to the Zone didn't appeal to everyone. Within the faction's ranks, some still remembered what true Duty once stood for. They gradually separated from the main body and occupied key points within the perimeter. Rumor has it they're being aided by the Military. It's highly probable the northern Zone awaits new clashes with many casualties...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Sectarianism].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! It would seem the war is finally over. The Zone is controlled by a single faction. But not long ago, its priorities changed. For some reason, mutants are no longer being actively exterminated. Everyone speaks of certain patrons from the north. Documents from the laboratories disappear in unknown directions. Among ordinary fighters, resentment is growing over their commanders' strange religious speeches. Not everyone is ready to have their brains washed by incomprehensible sermons. Especially those in the southern Zone. New contacts with the Military have already been established. And recent news about psi-installations being activated in the north made one thing clear: there's no turning back. Within the perimeter, a new «War in Zone» is about to begin...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Stability].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, the faction made contact with the government and began cooperation. Progress was slow, despite pressure from the outside world. Mutants were still being eradicated, artifacts still sought, scientists still protected. But everything moved at a sluggish pace. Some got the impression that the leadership wasn't in a hurry to fight the Zone's manifestations. Certain individuals claimed the upper echelons were stalling to enrich themselves as much as possible
column3: others said faction leaders didn't want to lose the power they held. Discontent among rank-and-file fighters was practically nonexistent, as no one was shortchanged on earnings - but ideologically driven commanders began preparing a coup...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Stalkers].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, faction leadership increasingly shifted the emphasis of their propaganda. Artifact hunting, cooperation with the government and scientists became routine. Bandits in the Zone disappeared, and any racketeering was nipped in the bud, making it slightly easier to earn money in the Zone. But while the government didn't openly conflict with the faction's upper echelons, it was preparing plans to take the Zone under its control...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Unknow].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, Duty made contact with the government and began cooperation. Mutants were being eradicated, scientists were being sent into the Zone more frequently. Duty members increasingly noticed secret service agents among them - though perhaps those were just rumors...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Unknow].Text-End-Standart-Lose
General Voronin: Your faction has been completely wiped out in the northern Zone. The group will not recover from such losses for a long time and is unlikely to be taken seriously by other Stalkers anytime soon. Defeat!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.Duty.Zombie].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! The C-Consciousness is now safe. Soon, psi-emission covered the entire Zone thanks to an increased number of emitters. Even the Cordon became dangerous. While the government still didn't allow mutants to escape the Zone, it no longer attempted to reclaim it...

The government decided to stop the spread of classified information and quickly began preparing a new operation to storm the northern Zone... Meanwhile, Duty is also recovering fast and clearly wants in on this. Very soon, a new stage of bloody slaughter for the northern Zone will begin...

Rumors say government forces are working among the leadership, as certain key territories and the Chernobyl NPP itself were announced to be placed under Military control. Some commanders have already refused to obey orders from the top and are forming a unified resistance network. It seems a new stage of the «War in Zone» is coming...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.freedom.Crime].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, the Zone was declared a free quasi-state. But the faction's recent shift toward criminal activity led to new chaos in the Zone. Within a week, a power struggle and turf wars began. This resulted in new mass battles across the entire Exclusion Zone. The Military has already prepared plans to seize key locations, and assaults are about to begin. A new «War in Zone» is already starting...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.freedom.Stalkers].Text-End-Standart-Victory

Everyone in the Zone discusses the faction's successes and prospects, but current faction goals differ from the original ones about revealing the Zone's secrets to the world. But a few scandals after media publications guaranteed the government some trouble. After that, the state increased pressure on the faction's upper echelons, which led to a split. The once-unified faction fractured into several smaller ones. However, this didn't lead to a new war, only to occasional minor conflicts. The Military, deciding this was their chance, began preparing for a new operation to seize key locations in the Zone. Can the fractured faction defend the territory? Unknown...

General Voronin: Monolith - a faction serving as the shield of the C-Consciousness. Primary goal: protect the Zone from any external interference. Extremely hostile to all other factions. Despite advantages in weaponry, it has problems controlling its territories, as it's located in the northern Zone.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-War
General Voronin: Locate and eradicate!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
General Voronin: The Monolith commands us to make peace with you. Do you agree, or what?

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
General Voronin: The Monolith commands us to become your friends.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-BreakAlliance
General Voronin: The Monolith is displeased with our alliance!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask
General Voronin: By the will of the Great Monolith, we send you a request for a monetary transfer for our brothers in the following amount:

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down
General Voronin: Detect and eradicate! *Speaker has added you to their blacklist*

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Down
General Voronin: The Monolith would certainly not approve of this! *Speaker has removed you from friends*

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
General Voronin: You shall know the wrath of the Monolith! *Speaker has left the chat*

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
General Voronin: And the day shall come, and the Monolith shall shine again in its glory! *Speaker has left the chat*

General Voronin: The Monolith will certainly not give its consent. *Speaker has left the chat*

General Voronin: Then we shall find you and destroy you!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-Yes
General Voronin: It could be no other way. All by the will of the Great Monolith!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-No
General Voronin: You do wrong by not following the will of the Monolith.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-Yes
General Voronin: Let our brothers rejoice and our enemies tremble!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down
General Voronin: We'll grind you to dust!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Down
General Voronin: How exactly are we supposed to understand that?

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
General Voronin: No, we cannot turn a blind eye to your presence in the Zone.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
General Voronin: Alright, we'll turn a blind eye to your presence in the Zone...

General Voronin: The Army needs an ally in the Zone. Fine, we agree.

General Voronin: No, we do not provide financial assistance!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.soldiers.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-Yes
General Voronin: Yes, command has agreed to help you with finances.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.soldiers.Anarchy].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! The government has taken control of the Zone and, upon reviewing documents from the laboratories, immediately decided to classify everything. But part of the documentation somehow ended up in public hands. Weapons, human experiments, the cause of the Zone's appearance... Now much of this has become public knowledge...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.soldiers.AntiZone].Text-End-Standart-Victory

Weapons, human experiments, the cause of the Zone's appearance... Now this will remain a secret forever... The new priority became the destruction of any manifestations of the Zone. Primary target: mutants. Special groups armed with shotguns and flamethrowers were formed to destroy any creature, even if it was just small rats. Eliminate anomalous manifestations of the Zone - the new government order that must be carried out.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.soldiers.Control].Text-End-Standart-Lose
General Voronin: No Military remain in the Zone... Now it's unknown how things will end without government forces. You have been demoted for failure! Defeat!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.soldiers.Crime].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! The government has taken control of the Zone. But corruption and negligence flourished. For raids against mutants, somehow there was never enough equipment - either it was unserviceable, or simply not in stock... Perimeter security of the Exclusion Zone wasn't focused on guarding, but on collecting bribes for smuggling prohibited items, such as artifacts. It's unknown where such careless attitude toward the Zone will lead, but hardly to anything good...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.soldiers.Exploring].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Government forces managed to take control of the entire Exclusion Zone and are now rapidly restoring order. The new priority became ensuring the safety of research groups. Various small squads of special forces soldiers were formed for operations in particularly hazardous conditions. These included underground complexes and laboratories, which, to the generals' surprise, turned out to be several times more numerous than initially assumed. All obtained information was rapidly classified, and the public knew about the Zone only what the government told them.

Some began engaging in suspicious contracts from private firms. Various small squads of soldiers formed, engaged in artifact hunting and mutant capture for private «collectors». Service or money? This question was asked by everyone without exception...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.soldiers.Sectarianism].Text-End-Standart-Victory

The SBU reported a certain element of sectarianism among commanders, but further investigation proved impossible. Commanders skillfully covered their tracks. So well, in fact, that even the C-Consciousness mentioned in found documents was never located...

Thus, the so-called «artifact oligarchs» eventually appeared...

An advantage can be considered their predisposition to artifact hunting, which will favorably affect their financial standing in capable hands. However, the territories under their control are scattered across locations, which brings greater difficulty in holding them. The faction must determine its development priorities.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Anarchy].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, the unified Stalker faction developed a set of rules similar to those of Freedom, but with some clear differences. Emphasis was placed on money, not ideology. After some time, «separate» groups by "interests" began forming within the faction, leading to a split at the top. Many began saying that a new stage of the «War in Zone» would soon begin...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.stalkers.AntiZone].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, the unified Stalker faction developed a set of rules similar to those of Duty, but without the military slant. Not everyone approved, but dissenters remained silent, as the new leadership fought with all its might against any manifestations of the Zone, allowing safer artifact collection and no fear of bandits. Mutant hunting was put on an assembly line, so even blind dogs weren't encountered in the south. Faction command actively cooperated with Scientists and tried not to conflict with the Military, leading to a new stage of Zone study - but its secrets were revealed to the public extremely reluctantly.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Control].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, Stalkers developed a set of rules designed to establish order in the Zone. Even military ranks were replaced with tiers. No trace remained of the old command confusion. A clear system of subordination and command was established
column3: newcomers to the Zone were forcibly integrated into this hierarchy, and those who disagreed were immediately handed over to the Military beyond the Cordon without further discussion. Rumors circulated that people from military command sat in the faction's upper echelons, but no one could prove it. Or perhaps they didn't have time to publish proof before being taken by the Military in an unknown direction. The Zone became less open, but safer - especially for government organizations.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Crime].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, Stalkers created a rule that there would be only one faction in the Zone, and every person must pay a share, while traders were taxed. Those who couldn't pay were handed over to the Military beyond the Cordon. The Zone became less open for study by government forces, and the criminal nature of the order reduced the influx of new people to Stalker-guarded territory.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Exploring].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, the faction of free Stalkers began actively cooperating with all Scientists within the Zone. Harvesting mutant body parts, artifacts, measuring anomalous activity... Everyone began earning a living this way. A real hunt began for any documents from underground laboratories. It wasn't enough just to obtain them... You still had to somehow deliver these papers to the nearest Scientists' bunker. And it didn't help that there were now an order of magnitude more bunkers. Bounty hunters - the new scourge of the Zone. If anyone learns that some Stalker has even one paper from a laboratory or, at the very least, a somewhat valuable item for Scientists... You can safely write them off as dead. They won't reach a single bunker. People in the Zone divided into two groups: those who obtain, and those who hunt those who managed to obtain something. Shooting everywhere. Gradually, the Zone became more and more dangerous...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Growth].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, free Stalkers created a rule that there would no longer be any factions in the Zone, and those who decided to engage in banditry were handed over to the Military beyond the Cordon. The Zone became open for study to all who wished. And less dangerous.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Growth].Text-End-Standart-Lose
General Voronin: Loners have been completely destroyed
column3: now only factions will divide the Zone. No free Stalkers remain! Defeat!

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Mercenary].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, the faction of free Stalkers began to resemble ordinary mercenaries more and more. The clear hierarchy crumbled, the faction fragmented. "Contracts" began ruling the current order. Murders increased so much that the Zone became full of "professional hitmen". But while people fought each other for the money they loved so much, the Zone became much more dangerous, as far less attention was paid to monsters than should have been. Rumor had it that new, previously unknown and extremely dangerous monsters had been spotted at the Cordon several times already.

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Sectarianism].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, the faction of free Stalkers began to resemble sectarians more and more. "At the bottom", rumors circulated that "the top" was under the influence of "certain forces from the north". Religious phrases appeared more frequently in commanders' speeches. Active combat operations were waged against government forces to expand their influence beyond the perimeter. With each day, more and more brainwashing was conducted among faction members - but some managed to resist and protect their minds. Most of them were in the south, as they weren't affected by psi-installations, which had been reactivated. A new stage of the «War in Zone» was brewing...

[Leaders.Leader-4].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Stability].Text-End-Standart-Victory
General Voronin: Victory! Soon, due to the lack of external enemies, the faction of free Stalkers began searching for them within themselves. Intrigues, scandals, executions... That's what the faction turned into. Stalkers' tasks devolved to guarding and clearing main routes in the Zone, while remote areas received almost no attention. This led to an increase in the number of mutants and those who fled there from all this internal strife. The faction cooperated with Scientists and the Military, but not very willingly, which led government forces to consider creating a new base within the perimeter - which could lead to new clashes within the Zone's perimeter...
